text: In 2020, the Toronto Transit Commission Board adopted a motion directing Toronto Transit Commission staff to report on the costs to install bilingual signage in any existing subway station undergoing renovation and on the costs to make all new wayfinding signage bilingual. At the invitation of the Chair, Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee, representatives from the Toronto Transit Commission will present the findings of their report to the Committee.
The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee received the item for information.
